label: Exploratory V5 C4 with prepared Spoolburst and Threadball Threadback Unweave candidate F3
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, reward, UI, or asset authority.
It keeps Candidate C4's ideal-direct-hit range/damage values, forward-Stitch, and equal 128-unit Escape Slack reserve.

Spoolburst cannot be cast immediately. Its caster spends one full in-range turn preparing it; the charge survives exactly the opponent's next action and is available only as a stationary cast on the caster's immediately following turn if the target remains in range.

There is no Cocoon. A normal Threadball Strike deals its normal 45 ideal direct damage and does not cancel preparation. A zero-damage Threadball Unweave cancels preparation, then forces its caster one full 64-unit step away from the prepared opponent and spends exactly that caster's existing Escape Slack. The action is unavailable unless the full step is legal.
Fire still ends the caster's turn. Terrain, aim, splash, animation, UI, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
